title: Beyond the Johnson Bound: A Path to Smaller Post-Quantum SNARKs
description:
What mathematics lies behind the Ethereum Foundation's $1M Proximity Prize, and why does it matter for cryptographic proofs?

This workshop builds an intuitive understanding of Reed Solomon codes, polynomial encoding, decoding radii, and the Johnson bound. We then introduce Mutual Correlated Agreement (MCA) through simple mathematical examples, giving participants the foundations needed to understand the central question of the Proximity Prize and why solving it is challenging.

We explore cutting edge research on soundness bounds beyond the Johnson bound, including recent results by Dao, Kominers, and Thaler, and discuss how stronger guarantees can reduce verifier queries and proof sizes in FRI and WHIR.

Finally, we introduce better.codes, Lean 4 formal verification, and opportunities to contribute to these open mathematical problems.

The workshop includes interactive quizzes and audience discussion. No prior coding theory background is required.
abstract:
How can stronger mathematical guarantees make post quantum SNARKs smaller?

This interactive workshop introduces the mathematics behind Reed Solomon codes, list decoding, the Johnson bound, and Mutual Correlated Agreement (MCA), building toward the Ethereum Foundation's $1M Proximity Prize.

Through visual examples and interactive quizzes, we explore the mathematical challenges behind the prize, the latest research on soundness bounds beyond the Johnson bound, and how these results can enable smaller cryptographic proofs.

We conclude with better.codes and how Lean 4 can help advance formally verified mathematical research.
